about.title: About
about.body: All-Science Sims is a free, client-side collection of original interactive simulations covering physics, chemistry, biology, earth & space, computer science, data science, and social science. Every sim is hand-built in vanilla JavaScript, runs entirely in your browser, and works in English or Bahasa Indonesia. Useful for students, teachers, self-learners, and anyone curious about science.
